description: List the playbooks available: the ones Avokata ships and any this account has written. Call this when you want the procedure for a legal task rather than inventing one.

limit.description: How many playbooks to return, default 50 (jobs are always listed whole: there are few and they come first).
limit.title: Limit

max_chars.description: A hard cap on the answer's size in characters, default 15000. Rows are dropped from the end to fit, and `truncated` says how many and how to get them.
max_chars.title: Max Chars

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: list_workflows
title: List playbooks and jobs
